<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#050403">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:#050403;overflow:hidden}
canvas{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in a dark, warmly lit room"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
'use strict';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
if (!ctx) return;

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const smooth = (a, b, x) => { const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
const mixc = (a, b, t) => [lerp(a[0], b[0], t), lerp(a[1], b[1], t), lerp(a[2], b[2], t)];
const rgbStr = c => 'rgb(' + (c[0] | 0) + ',' + (c[1] | 0) + ',' + (c[2] | 0) + ')';
const rgbaStr = (c, a) => 'rgba(' + (c[0] | 0) + ',' + (c[1] | 0) + ',' + (c[2] | 0) + ',' + a + ')';

function rng(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
    let t = s;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let reduced = mq.matches;

let W = 1, H = 1, dpr = 1, T = 0;
let bg = null, bgM = 28, grainPat = null, grainX = 0, grainY = 0, frameNo = 0;
const base = { cx: 0, cy: 0, R: 100 };
const B = {};
const par = { x: 0, y: 0 };
const light = { x: 0, y: 0 };
const ptr = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, active: false, touch: false, t: 0, ms: 0, lastRip: -1, over: false };
let flick = 1, LX = 0, LY = 0;
let PX = 0, PY = 0;

function computeBase() {
  base.R = Math.min(W * 0.43, H * 0.30);
  base.cx = W / 2;
  base.cy = H * 0.60;
}

function layout() {
  const R = base.R;
  B.R = R;
  B.k = 0.40 - par.y * 0.028;
  B.cx = base.cx;
  B.cy = base.cy;
  B.irx = R * 0.925;
  B.iry = B.irx * B.k;
  B.brx = B.irx * 0.955;
  B.bry = B.brx * B.k;
  B.bcx = B.cx + par.x * R * 0.02;
  B.bcy = B.cy + B.iry * 0.2;
  B.Hb = R * 0.78;
  B.f = 0.42;
}

function proj(u, v, h) {
  PX = B.bcx + u * B.brx - par.x * h * B.R * 0.10;
  PY = B.bcy + v * B.bry - h * B.R;
}
function projW(u, v, dx, dz, h) {
  PX = B.bcx + u * B.brx + dx * B.R - par.x * h * B.R * 0.10;
  PY = B.bcy + v * B.bry + dz * B.R * B.k - h * B.R;
}
function wAt(t) {
  return B.R * (B.f + (1 - B.f) * Math.pow(1 - t * t, 0.75));
}

/* ---------- scene data (unit coordinates, built once) ---------- */
const S = { strands: [], nori: [], slabs: [], mush: [], corn: [], floaters: [], beads: [], leaves: [] };
const MOUND = { u: -0.03, v: 0.03, rx: 0.62, ry: 0.47, h: 0.19 };
const NOODLE_DARK = [150, 96, 34];
const NOODLE_LIGHT = [240, 214, 140];

function moundH(u, v) {
  const nu = (u - MOUND.u) / MOUND.rx, nv = (v - MOUND.v) / MOUND.ry;
  const e = 1 - nu * nu - nv * nv;
  return e > 0 ? MOUND.h * Math.pow(e, 0.7) : 0;
}

function buildScene() {
  const r = rng(90210);

  const N = 62;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const f = i / (N - 1);
    const cv = lerp(-0.44, 0.50, f) + (r() - 0.5) * 0.03;
    const nv = (cv - MOUND.v) / MOUND.ry;
    const half = 0.66 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.05, 1 - nv * nv)) * (0.85 + r() * 0.3);
    S.strands.push({
      cu: MOUND.u + (r() - 0.5) * 0.12, cv, half,
      ang: (r() - 0.5) * 0.8,
      aw: 0.03 + r() * 0.07, wf: 1.0 + r() * 2.2, ph: r() * TAU,
      cf: 5 + r() * 4, cph: r() * TAU, cph2: r() * TAU,
      ca: 0.006 + r() * 0.008, lift: r() * 0.035,
      w: 0.0125 + r() * 0.0045, tone: r()
    });
  }
  const top = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const a = r() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.75;
    const cu = MOUND.u + Math.cos(a) * d * MOUND.rx;
    const cv = MOUND.v + Math.sin(a) * d * MOUND.ry;
    const sgn = r() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    top.push({
      cu, cv, half: 0.22 + r() * 0.16,
      ang: sgn * (0.7 + r() * 0.5),
      aw: 0.04 + r() * 0.05, wf: 1.2 + r() * 1.6, ph: r() * TAU,
      cf: 4 + r() * 3, cph: r() * TAU, cph2: r() * TAU,
      ca: 0.006 + r() * 0.006, lift: 0.03 + r() * 0.03,
      w: 0.0125 + r() * 0.004, tone: 0.4 + r() * 0.6
    });
  }
  top.sort((a, b) => a.cv - b.cv);
  for (const s of top) S.strands.push(s);

  const edgeJit = () => Array.from({ length: 9 }, () => r() - 0.5);
  S.nori.push({ u: 0.50, v: -0.52, w: 0.40, h: 0.56, lean: 0.10, skew: 0.02, ph: 1.2, edge: edgeJit() });
  S.nori.push({ u: 0.28, v: -0.66, w: 0.36, h: 0.48, lean: -0.05, skew: -0.015, ph: 4.0, edge: edgeJit() });

  S.leaves = [
    { ang: -2.75, len: 0.40, wid: 0.20, bend: 0.10, ph: 0.3 },
    { ang: -2.35, len: 0.55, wid: 0.24, bend: 0.10, ph: 1.9 },
    { ang: -1.55, len: 0.48, wid: 0.22, bend: 0.12, ph: 3.1 },
    { ang: -1.95, len: 0.60, wid: 0.26, bend: -0.05, ph: 4.4 }
  ];

  const tofu = { top1: [206, 140, 60], top2: [140, 86, 30], side: [240, 220, 172], sideDark: [150, 120, 74], marks: true };
  const menma = { top1: [216, 168, 96], top2: [176, 124, 54], side: [150, 104, 44], sideDark: [92, 60, 22], fibers: true };
  const addSlab = (p, cols) => {
    const s = Object.assign({}, p, cols);
    s.rise = moundH(s.u, s.v) * 0.85 + s.base;
    S.slabs.push(s);
  };
  const mm = [[-0.46, -0.02, 0.5], [-0.40, 0.12, -0.3], [-0.53, 0.10, 1.0], [-0.30, -0.14, 0.1], [-0.36, 0.02, -0.9]];
  mm.forEach((m, i) => addSlab({ u: m[0], v: m[1], ang: m[2], lx: 0.17, lz: 0.05, th: 0.03, base: 0.012, ph: i * 1.3 }, menma));
  addSlab({ u: 0.52, v: 0.12, ang: 0.35, lx: 0.30, lz: 0.21, th: 0.05, base: 0.012, ph: 0.7 }, tofu);
  addSlab({ u: 0.14, v: 0.46, ang: -0.25, lx: 0.28, lz: 0.20, th: 0.05, base: 0.012, ph: 2.1 }, tofu);
  S.slabs.sort((a, b) => a.v - b.v);

  S.mush.push({ u: 0.66, v: 0.34, r: 0.125, h: 0.02, ph: 0.4, rot: 0.3 });
  S.mush.push({ u: -0.55, v: 0.40, r: 0.115, h: 0.02, ph: 2.6, rot: 1.1 });

  const cornCols = [[242, 194, 58], [248, 206, 72], [232, 178, 44]];
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    const a = r() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.09;
    S.corn.push({
      u: -0.22, v: 0.50, dx: Math.cos(a) * d, dz: Math.sin(a) * d,
      h: 0.012 + r() * 0.012, r: 0.019 + r() * 0.005,
      col: cornCols[(r() * 3) | 0], ph: r() * TAU
    });
  }

  const scal = [['#3f9a2b', '#b9e37e'], ['#4aa632', '#c4eb8a'], ['#35852a', '#a8d874']];
  const place = () => {
    let u, v;
    do { const a = r() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.86; u = Math.cos(a) * d; v = Math.sin(a) * d; } while (v > 0.62);
    return [u, v];
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
    const p = place();
    const c = scal[(r() * 3) | 0];
    S.floaters.push({ type: 0, u: p[0], v: p[1], r: 0.026 + r() * 0.012, c1: c[0], c2: c[1], ph: r() * TAU });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
    const p = place();
    S.floaters.push({ type: 1, u: p[0], v: p[1], r: 0.008 + r() * 0.004, dark: r() < 0.15, rot: r() * Math.PI, ph: r() * TAU });
  }
  for (const f of S.floaters) f.hm = moundH(f.u, f.v) > 0.02 ? moundH(f.u, f.v) * 0.9 + 0.008 : 0.004;
  S.floaters.sort((a, b) => a.v - b.v);

  for (let i = 0; i < 92; i++) {
    const d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.9;
    S.beads.push({
      d, a0: r() * TAU, w: 0.028 * (1.15 - d) + (r() - 0.5) * 0.006,
      r: 0.006 + Math.pow(r(), 2.2) * 0.05, chili: false, ph: r() * TAU
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
    const d = Math.sqrt(r()) * 0.88;
    S.beads.push({
      d, a0: r() * TAU, w: 0.028 * (1.15 - d) + (r() - 0.5) * 0.006,
      r: 0.012 + r() * 0.03, chili: true, ph: r() * TAU
    });
  }
}

/* ---------- sprites, grain ---------- */
const sprites = [];
function makeCloud(rgb, seed) {
  const s = 160, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = s;
  const g = c.getContext('2d'), r = rng(seed);
  for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    const a = r() * TAU, d = r() * s * 0.10;
    const x = s / 2 + Math.cos(a) * d, y = s / 2 + Math.sin(a) * d * 1.2;
    const rad = s * (0.16 + r() * 0.12);
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rad);
    gr.addColorStop(0, rgbaStr(rgb, 0.42));
    gr.addColorStop(0.5, rgbaStr(rgb, 0.16));
    gr.addColorStop(1, rgbaStr(rgb, 0));
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);
  }
  return c;
}
function buildSprites() {
  const tints = [[255, 192, 124], [238, 226, 214], [188, 204, 226]];
  for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
    sprites[t] = [];
    for (let v = 0; v < 3; v++) sprites[t][v] = makeCloud(tints[t], 500 + v);
  }
}
function buildGrain() {
  const n = 128, c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = n;
  const g = c.getContext('2d'), img = g.createImageData(n, n), r = rng(31337);
  for (let i = 0; i < n * n; i++) {
    const v = r() > 0.5 ? 255 : 0;
    img.data[i * 4] = img.data[i * 4 + 1] = img.data[i * 4 + 2] = v;
    img.data[i * 4 + 3] = (r() * 44) | 0;
  }
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  grainPat = ctx.createPattern(c, 'repeat');
}

/*@@PART2@@*/
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
